prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE high-fidelity desktop website UI design image for the HOME PAGE of Nexlet, a Chinese Windows/macOS desktop toolbox. This is a completely new visual direction, not a screenshot of an existing website. Render a polished, buildable full page, flat front-on web canvas, approximately 1440px wide by 2000px tall. All interface copy in simplified Chinese, with the brand spelled exactly Nexlet. No browser chrome, no device mockup, no collage of different pages.
Visual direction: premium contemporary desktop-software website; confident oversized Chinese sans-serif typography, charcoal text, crisp white/off-white canvas, electric indigo-violet #6258ED, very pale lilac and cool blue luminous fields used selectively. Beautiful restrained depth, precise grids, generous whitespace but compact useful sections. Sophisticated product-led art direction. A refined rounded purple square with white N is the brand mark. Avoid the generic old layout of tiny text and repeated gray alternating screenshot blocks. No stock photos, humans, fake testimonials, user counts, stars, pricing, or performance claims.
Top navigation on white: logo Nexlet left; “概览”, “下载”, “隐私”, “插件开发” center; small GitHub icon and solid purple “下载 Nexlet” right.
Hero centered: small pill “为你的桌面而来”; huge two-line headline EXACTLY “常用工具，”“随叫随到。” where second line is indigo. Supporting line “搜索应用、找回复制、接着计算。一个入口，专注眼前的事。” Main CTA solid indigo with Windows icon “下载 Windows 版”; adjacent outlined CTA with Apple icon “下载 macOS 版”. Quiet note “预览版 · 选择平台直接下载安装包”.
A genuinely striking large product showcase beneath: a realistic, readable front-facing Nexlet light desktop launcher, wide rounded search input “搜索应用、工具或粘贴内容…”, keyboard chip “Alt + Space”, neat colorful icons labelled “剪贴板”, “计算稿纸”, “JSON”, “时间戳”, “网页快开”, “插件”. Behind/alongside within one pale lilac spotlight stage, tasteful overlapping small clipboard and calculator panels, with clear example 128 × 3 = 384 and 384 + 256 = 640. This is software UI, not abstract 3D decoration. Balanced, ample scale.
Below hero: heading “小事顺手，大事专注。” Then an asymmetric editorial bento grid, one wide clipboard card with well-designed list rows, one tall calculator card with elegant numeric results, two compact cards for “应用搜索” and “开发工具” with JSON { } and timestamp snippets. Subtle lavender/white surfaces, thin borders, distinct spacing. Copy short and legible.
Then a slim two-column section “数据留在本机，能力随你扩展。” with two concise links “了解数据与隐私” and “探索插件 API”, mini folder and code icons.
Finish with a confident lilac tinted download callout “下一步，从这里开始。” and direct Windows/macOS download buttons, then a minimal refined footer Nexlet / GitHub / 隐私 / 插件文档. The design is a concept, avoid exact version number and unverified platform support promises. Clear coherent hierarchy, delightful crafted visual quality.

Use case: ui-mockup. Render ONE high-fidelity desktop website full-page UI design image for Nexlet, in simplified Chinese, roughly 1440 wide x 1850 tall, flat front-on website canvas, no browser chrome, no device frame. Input image 1 is a VISUAL DESIGN SYSTEM REFERENCE, not content to repeat. Match its premium crisp white/off-white background, confident oversized charcoal Chinese sans-serif typography, indigo-violet #6258ED accents, very pale lilac fields, rounded 12-20px surfaces, extremely refined shadows and whitespace, consistent Nexlet rounded purple N brand. Keep identical top navigation logo Nexlet; “概览”, “下载”, “隐私”, “插件开发”; GitHub icon and purple “下载 Nexlet”. Each page must be distinctive and useful within the coherent same site. Legible Chinese hierarchy, not dense filler. Footer same restrained design. No testimonials, fake users, ratings, prices, speed claims, invented version numbers or file sizes. Do not display a fake web domain.
PAGE: 下载与入门, active nav 下载.
Headline centered “选好平台，马上开始。” with small label “下载 NEXLET” and supporting copy “你的桌面工具箱，准备就绪。”.
Primary content two large beautifully designed platform download panels side by side, each white with subtle indigo halo and border. Left large blue Windows icon, title “Windows”, small tag “x64 · 预览版”, dominant full-width purple button EXACT “下载 Windows 版”, secondary small “便携版 EXE”, subdued line “当前版本未签名”. Right large black Apple logo, title “macOS”, small tag “预览版”, two clearly separate download rows “Apple Silicon” with “下载” button and “Intel” with “下载” button; subdued line “尚未公证 · 自动回贴需辅助功能权限”. All CTAs are direct file downloads, not GitHub Releases navigation. There is no claim that installation files currently exist; this is intended UI design, avoid specific release numbers. Below both cards one lightweight text row “更新日志 ↗” “SHA-256 校验 ↗” and small platform notes.
Second content section left heading “三步，进入状态。” and right beautiful horizontal or numbered 01 02 03 onboarding with white rounded visual panels: “下载并打开” with package/file icon, “唤起 Nexlet” with large tactile keyboard caps “Alt” + “Space”, “搜索你要做的事” with small launcher search “剪贴板”. Keep it practical and polished.
Then compact accordion section “安装与使用，先了解这些。” with four clean rows: “快捷键被占用了怎么办？” “macOS 为什么需要辅助功能权限？” “预览版有哪些限制？” “如何检查安装包来源？”.
A soft lilac footer banner with small code icon “想自己构建？” and secondary “查看源码与构建说明 ↗”. Strong visual primary emphasis on download cards, refined near-production software download page.

Hero is a sophisticated restrained split composition: left small “数据与隐私”, huge headline EXACT “你的数据，”“留在你的设备。” and concise copy “剪贴板、稿纸和配置在本机保存。了解它们如何被记录、保留与管理。”; right a refined product-UI-like local storage diagram, white glass-like folder tile with Nexlet N, three smaller lavender tiles labelled “剪贴板” “计算稿纸” “配置与插件”, all enclosed subtly inside a rounded outline labelled “你的设备”. Section “插件只使用已授权的能力。” with three small permission rows clipboard.read / clipboard.write / shell.openExternal and “了解插件权限 →”.
Finish quiet support block “需要备份？先退出应用，再复制数据目录。” and footer. This page must feel trustworthy, sophisticated, warm, human, factual and visually interesting without making security promises.

Hero sophisticated two-column: left small technical pill “NEXLET PLUGIN API V1”; large headline EXACT “把你的工具，”“接进 Nexlet。” with second line violet; supportive “熟悉的 Web 技术，明确的桌面能力。”; primary purple button “阅读开发文档 ↗”, outlined “查看示例 ↗”. Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the Nexlet website home design. Images 2 and 3 are FACTUAL PRODUCT REFERENCES only. 1. In BOTH calculator previews (the upper hero floating panel and lower central feature card), completely remove traditional calculator number-pad keys.
